title: Your current electricity plan
hook: Two stated cases: explore the opportunity cost of keeping a current plan.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the opportunity cost of keeping a current plan affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gain, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the opportunity cost of keeping a current plan in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Keeping a toy option yields 100. Switching yields 120 and costs 5. What is the gain from switching?
